sections.title: Commercial roofing contractor serving Edinburg
paras: Edel Roofing is based in Edinburg and has been working on commercial properties across Hidalgo County since 2003. We install and repair flat and low-slope roofing systems for strip malls, office buildings, warehouses, churches, medical facilities, and apartment complexes. If your building is in Edinburg, we know the area and we can be on-site fast.

Commercial roofing is different from residential work. The systems are larger, the materials are different, and a leak or failure can shut down a business. We treat every commercial project with the same attention we give a full residential replacement, inspection first, written estimate, no surprises.

cards.title: Flat Roof Installation
cards.body: New flat and low-slope roof systems for commercial buildings. We install TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen membranes, the three most common systems for commercial properties in South Texas.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Replacement
cards.body: Full tear-off and replacement when a roof has reached the end of its useful life. We remove the old system, inspect the decking, and install a new commercial-grade roof from scratch.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Repairs
cards.body: Leak repairs, membrane patching, flashing repairs, and drain issues. We find the source of the problem and fix it, not just the visible damage, but what caused it.

cards.title: Roof Coatings
cards.body: Reflective coatings applied over an existing commercial roof to extend its life and reduce heat absorption. A cost-effective option when the underlying system is still sound but starting to show wear.

cards.title: Storm & Hail Damage
cards.body: Hidalgo County storms can hit commercial buildings hard. We inspect for hail damage, impact damage, and wind uplift, and we can help you understand what your insurance policy covers before you file a claim.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Inspections
cards.body: Routine inspections to catch problems before they become expensive. Useful for property managers, business owners buying a building, or anyone who wants a professional opinion on the condition of their roof.

sections.title: Commercial roofing in Edinburg: what we see most
paras: Edinburg is home to a wide range of commercial buildings, strip centers along Closner and McColl, warehouses near the Edinburg industrial areas, medical and professional offices near DHR Health, UTRGV campus buildings, and churches throughout the city. Most of them have flat or low-slope roofs.

The biggest challenge for commercial roofs in Edinburg is the same as everywhere in the RGV: extreme heat, UV exposure, and the occasional severe hailstorm. Flat roofs are especially vulnerable to ponding water after heavy rain if drains are clogged or the roof is not properly sloped. We inspect drainage as part of every commercial assessment.

If you manage multiple properties in Edinburg or Hidalgo County, we can set up a regular inspection schedule so problems get caught early and you're not dealing with emergency repairs during business hours.

faqs.q: What types of commercial roofs do you install in Edinburg?
faqs.a: We install TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen membrane systems, the most common flat and low-slope commercial roofing systems in South Texas. We also apply roof coatings for buildings that need extended life without a full replacement. We can recommend the right system for your building type, roof area, and budget.

faqs.q: How long does a commercial roof last in the Rio Grande Valley?
faqs.a: A well-installed commercial membrane system typically lasts 15 to 25 years in our climate, depending on the material and how well it is maintained. Heat and UV exposure shorten the lifespan compared to cooler regions. Regular inspections can catch small issues before they shorten that timeline significantly.

faqs.q: Do you work with property managers and building owners, not just business owners?
faqs.a: Yes. A significant part of our commercial work is with property managers overseeing multiple buildings and building owners who lease to tenants. We can work around tenant schedules, provide documentation for insurance and maintenance records, and set up recurring inspection agreements.

faqs.q: Can you help with an insurance claim for hail or storm damage to a commercial roof?
faqs.a: We can inspect the damage and give you a written report of what we find. That documentation is useful when you file a claim. We do not act as a public adjuster, but we can walk you through what we observed so you understand what to discuss with your insurance company.

faqs.q: How do I get a commercial roofing estimate in Edinburg?
faqs.a: Call us at (956) 422-3335 or book online. We will schedule a time to walk the roof, take measurements, and give you a written estimate. Commercial estimates are free and there is no obligation.
